extensionDescription.message: Shows which of your LinkedIn connections are "Open to Work" or "Hiring", so you can help them.

statusPaused.message: Paused: go back to the update window to continue.

statusNeverUpdated.message: You haven't updated your list yet.

emptyNoData.message: Click "Update list" to check your connections.

emptyNoConnections.message: None of your connections have this frame.

bannerNoticePaused.message: Come back to this window (on the connections page) to continue.

statusError.message: an error occurred, check the console

statusIncomplete.message: The last update was incomplete ($1 of $2 connections). Please try again.

bannerFinished.message: Done, you can close this window.

statusIncompleteNoTotal.message: The last update was incomplete ($1 connections checked). Please try again.

bannerProgressWithTotal.message: $1 of $2 connections checked · $3 with a frame

bannerNoticeDirect.message: You can leave this window minimized or in the background, but don't close it until the process has finished.

bannerNoticeDiscovering.message: Getting ready to read your connections. Keep this window visible for a few seconds and don't close it until the process has finished.

bannerNoticeScroll.message: Keep this window visible and don't close it until the process has finished. As connections are read, their cards and photos are removed from this window so it runs faster and uses less memory.
